Detached House for Rent – Vancouver Arbutus Area | Great School Catchment、

Special rate of $4,800/month for move-in before October 1.

Video link of property：https://youtu.be/O1X_H-KK5zc?si=FMNURG0uhc3c_qcG

Welcome to this spacious detached home located in Vancouver’s highly desirable Arbutus area. Situated on a quiet and convenient residential street, this home is ideal for a family looking for a comfortable long-term rental in an excellent school catchment.

Home Features
4 bedrooms
2 bathrooms
2 spacious living rooms
1 full kitchen
2-car garage
Professional yard maintenance included
Excellent Location

School catchment
Conveniently located close to Prince of Wales Secondary School and Trafalgar Elementary School.

Enjoy easy access to nearby amenities, including Safeway, Choices Market, restaurants, and other shops, many within walking distance.

The property also offers convenient public transportation, with easy bus access to UBC and Downtown Vancouver.

Important Information About the Lower Level

A licensed daycare operates on the lower level during daytime hours only. The daycare has a completely separate entrance, and there is no interior connection between the daycare and the rental home.

No one lives on the lower level
No daycare operation in the evenings
No daycare operation on weekends or statutory holidays

The upper living space is exclusively for the tenants.

We are looking for responsible, clean, and long-term tenants.

Minimum one-year lease required.

Please contact us with a brief introduction about yourself and the people who will be living in the home to arrange a viewing.
